### Datto RMM autonomous execution control
This page manages Jason's **standing autonomous approval registry** for the complete live Datto RMM component catalog.

- **Checked:** Jason may select the component without asking for a per-run approval, subject to its normal managed-endpoint and variable guardrails.
- **Unchecked:** exact technician instruction/approval is required for a run unless another standing policy applies.
- Components classified as disruptive/destructive or generic ad-hoc PowerShell remain **ineligible** and cannot be bulk-approved here.
- **Select All Eligible** selects every component that Jason's server-side safety policy currently permits; **Apply Autonomous Approvals** shows a confirmation before writing the bulk delta.

panels.title: Datto RMM Component Catalog and Autonomous Policy
panels.description: Authoritative live Datto component catalog. Safety-blocked rows remain per-run even when bulk selection is used.

panels.title: Autonomous Component Approvals
panels.description: Select exactly which eligible Datto RMM components Jason may choose and run without a per-run technician approval. Safety-blocked components cannot be selected here.
